race.description: Tabtouch - Westspeed Platinum Series Heat 2 Hcp
race.comment: DIRTY HABITS (7) was too good at Pinjarra last time when breaking his maiden as a $1.60 favourite. He was beaten over this trip prior at the short quote again, but there's no hiding his ability. Nottle rides now and his latest effort looks right up to this. Can repeat the dose. GOD'S GATE (1) loves this trip, just missing by 0.7L at this track most recently after getting every chance in the run. Steve Parnham remains on board from an inside barrier and his recent figures stack up. Can get the job done this time around. GOD'S CROSS (2) flew home from the back half of the field to just miss over 1200m at Bunbury on resumption. The form out of that race has stood up and he was competitive in 3YO Open races prior to the break. Can build on the fresh effort. DIAMOND WARRIOR (6) won't be far away on his recent form.
